gloss: to be completed, to be finished, to be ready

definitions.gloss: to be completed, to be finished, to be ready
definitions.explanation: For something to reach a state of completion. Used for food being cooked, work being done, products being manufactured, etc.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}が{出来上|できあ}がった。
レポートがやっと{出来上|できあ}がった。
{新|あたら}しいビルが{出来上|できあ}がるまで、あと{半年|はんとし}かかるそうだ。
examples.english: I hear it will take another six months until the new building is completed.

notes:
{出来上|できあ}がる is the intransitive counterpart of {仕上|しあ}げる. It focuses on the result — the state of being complete.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- No direct object; the completed thing is the subject

ASPECT (ている):
- {出来上|できあ}がっている: is already completed/finished (resultant state)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料理|りょうり}が{出来上|できあ}がる (the food is ready)
- {作品|さくひん}が{出来上|できあ}がる (a work is completed)
- きれいに{出来上|できあ}がる (to turn out beautifully)
- うまく{出来上|できあ}がる (to turn out well)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完成|かんせい}する: to be completed (more formal, for projects/works)
- {出来上|できあ}がる: to be finished (broader use, including cooking)
